text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as being dragged around by Sasami Anshinzawa
as a guinea pig for her sasabari acupuncture
had become my everyday normal, one day――
Come here... Come this way...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Bzzzt, wrong!
It was me, Sasami Anshinzawa, the genius acupuncturist~☆
Well, my needle skills really are divine, though!
choice_data_list: Umm... what can I do for you?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Look~,
doesn't it seem like your progress has stalled lately?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I was just thinking that maybe I should stick you
with an even bigger and badder needle~♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Come on, come on! No need to be so shy,
<username>♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: I'll open a brand new door for you! ☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
—*Stab*... *tab*... *ab*...
(Self-echo)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In that instant――unfamiliar visions and a mysterious voice
came flooding into my head...!

text_block_list.name: Founder of Sasabari
text_block_list.text:
So this is bamboo needle acupuncture――
the power to bring salvation to Umamusume...!

text_block_list.name: Nameless Acupuncturist A
text_block_list.text:
Please... oh please, let my treatments
bring reassuuurance to all the Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Nameless Acupuncturist B
text_block_list.text:
What an unbelievable run...!
I want to make their dreams... stick true!

text_block_list.name: Nameless Acupuncturist C
text_block_list.text:
To carve open the future with sasabari acupuncture……
That…… is our wish――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I can feel someone's wishes, their intense feelings,
being entrusted to me—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My chest burns hot...
Power is surging throughout my whole body!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?!
Where are you goiiing?!

text_block_list.name: Running Mate A
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?!
<chrname>'s Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Running Mate B
text_block_list.text:
No way, no way, that's way too fast!
...Im-possi-ble~!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Astounding!!
To think he could pull off a run capable of going toe-to-toe with an Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Astounding!!
To think she could pull off a run capable of going toe-to-toe with an Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Could you secretly be an Umamusume too, Trainer—
No, surely that cannot be...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Yay, we did it~♪
Did everybody see my skills?! Wowza☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I got to train alongside <chrname>
to our hearts' content!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as Sasami Anshinzawa said,
I feel like a brand-new door has opened within me...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day after spending that miraculous time together—

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Those acupuncture needles worked wonders, didn't they~!
Your run was practically like an Umamusume's!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Wait, oh?
You look completely wiped out, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Yikes! So since the effect is so strong,
the kickback is just as big?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
No need to worry, though!
Keep training like this, and sooner or later
you'll power up with zero recoil!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her words sounded thoroughly suspicious, but――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If such a day ever comes,
I'd really love to run alongside <chrname>
one more time, I thought.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If such a day ever comes,
I'd really love to run alongside <chrname>
one more time, I thought.
